prompts.crimson_seal:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE production-ready transparent VFX sprite for a 2D Touhou-inspired lane-defense game, square 1024 x 1024 canvas.
Primary request: a crimson Hakurei sealing-circle illustration. Centered front-facing round hollow magic seal: two elegantly inked vermilion circular wards, a delicate central yin-yang motif, six ivory paper talismans with abstract brush marks orbiting the rim, short warm pink light strokes and tiny red sparks. Authentic Japanese fantasy spell aesthetic, detailed hand-painted 2D cel art with crisp silhouettes and restrained soft glow, harmonious with chibi pixel-inspired boss sprites.
Composition: complete isolated effect centered with at least 10 percent entirely transparent safety margin; an airy transparent interior so the character remains clearly visible; circle diameter 75 percent of canvas. Soft glow must fade completely to transparency.
Constraints: genuinely transparent RGBA background, preserve glow alpha; no opaque white/black background, no checkerboard painted into image, no character, no environment, no UI, no readable text, no watermark, no rectangular border. Keep central glow gentle and avoid a solid luminous disk. A single effect sprite, not a sprite sheet.
